Explicit federal annual pack is available.

Confirm a living individual’s ordinary full-year Canadian resident return, all income allocated to Nova Scotia, no separate return, bankruptcy, trust or foreign provincial allocation. Special schedules are entered as reviewed amounts.
Confirm federal credit-dollar amounts, special schedules, income adjustments, provincial tax, payments and refundable credits are complete and reviewed. Zero means confirmed none, not unknown.
Shared core, federal review and ordinary scope are satisfied.
Progressive federal tax on shared taxable income. The lowest annual rate is 14.5% in 2025 and 14% in 2026.
Signed adjustment to net income for the basic-personal phase-out under s118(1.1): exclude applicable s79/s40(3.21) gains and add back s20(1)(ww). Enter zero if none.
Basic personal amount reduced linearly from the maximum to the minimum across the fourth income bracket.

Choose Claim amounts for ordinary federal amounts before the credit rate, or Credit dollars for already-calculated reductions from an older export. Donations and top-up are always final credit dollars.
Federal nonrefundable credit rate: 14.5% for 2025, 14% for 2026. Donations and top-up are added after this rate.
Basic personal credit. Optional override follows Credit input basis: base amount in Claim amounts mode; final reduction in Credit dollars mode. Blank uses the automatic income-dependent base.

Other ordinary federal claims absent from named fields, after eligibility limits. Enter claim bases in Claim amounts mode or final reductions in Credit dollars mode. Exclude donations, top-up and every separately entered amount.
Total ordinary claim bases, including the selected basic personal amount. Available only in Claim amounts mode. Donations and top-up excluded.
Ordinary claim amounts multiplied once by the annual credit rate, rounded once. Credit dollars mode instead sums already-calculated reductions.
Ordinary nonrefundable credit plus donations and top-up credit dollars. Neither donations nor top-up is multiplied by the ordinary rate.
Federal bracket tax plus TOSI, less nonrefundable credits, dividend credit and minimum-tax carryover, floored at zero.
Investment tax credit recapture from Form T2038(IND).
Permitted federal logging tax credit after limits.
Basic federal tax less the permitted foreign credit, plus investment credit recapture, less logging credit, floored at zero. Foreign surtax is outside the ordinary NS allocation scope.
Permitted nonrefundable investment tax credit after limits and recapture review. Refundable ITC belongs in payments.
Permitted federal labour-sponsored funds credit after applicable limits.
Federal tax after political, investment and labour-sponsored credits, floored at zero.

Has T691 determined the amount to report on line 41700? If yes, enter the FINAL line 41700 amount from T691 in Minimum tax in Other tax & filing. This replaces regular tax; it is not an added AMT amount.
Line 41700: regular calculation, or the reviewed final T691 result when the minimum-tax schedule applies.
Advanced Canada workers benefit amount required on line 41500 from Schedule 6. Enter the CWB credit separately among refundable credits.
Reviewed total special taxes included on T1 line 41800. Exclude TOSI, AMT, OAS/EI repayments and taxes reported on separate returns (including separate registered-plan tax forms).
Line 41700 plus ACWB and line 41800 special taxes. Inspection amount; final output is review gated.
Reviewed net federal tax; does not include provincial tax or contributions and repayments on Step 6.
CPP payable on self-employment and other earnings from Schedule 8/RC381. Separate from the deductible and creditable CPP portions already included in income/credits.
EI premiums payable on self-employment and other eligible earnings from Schedule 13.
EI benefits repayment included in line 23500/42200. Exclude the OAS recovery tax supplied in Other tax & filing. Review the corresponding income deduction separately.
OAS recovery tax plus EI benefits repayment. Review any corresponding net-income deduction; do not deduct the payable twice.
Reviewed NS tax read by reference from the separate provincial module.
Shared minimum-tax carryover agrees with the amount entered for NS, and no NS additional minimum tax is claimed when T691 is not used. Other special-schedule correspondence remains subject to review.
Combined federal and provincial tax plus CPP/EI payable and social benefits repayment, before payments and refundable credits.
CPP/QPP overpayment from Schedule 8 or RC381. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
EI overpayment. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Refundable medical expense supplement. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Canada workers benefit from Schedule 6; ACWB goes separately on line 41500. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Canada training credit from Schedule 11. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Multigenerational home renovation credit from Schedule 12. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Refundable investment tax credit. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Part XII.2 credit from applicable slips. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Employee/partner GST/HST rebate from GST370; not GST/HST benefit payments. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Eligible educator school supply CREDIT DOLLARS after the 25% rate and $1,000 expense limit. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Canadian journalism labour tax credit. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Return of fuel-charge proceeds to farmers credit. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Reviewed NS479 refundable credits; separate from NS428 nonrefundable credits. Enter zero only after confirming none applies.
Sum of reviewed refundable-credit and overpayment amounts, excluding withholding and instalments. Quebec abatement is not applicable to this NS scope.
Tax withheld, instalments, refundable credits and overpayments. Do not include benefits paid outside the T1 reconciliation.
Signed reconciliation: total payable minus credits/payments. Positive means owing; negative means a calculated refund.
Calculated balance owing, floored at zero. Excludes arrears, interest, penalties, CRA account offsets and assessment changes.
Calculated refund magnitude, floored at zero; not a refund already assessed or issued by CRA.
